{{Otheruses|Commander}}
[[File:AhsokaTano-SWI140.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka Tano served as a Jedi Commander.]]
{{Quote|Master, if you're now a general, what does that make me?|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: The Battle of Jabiim">''[[Star Wars: Republic: The Battle of Jabiim]]''</ref>}}
'''Jedi Commander''' was a rank in the military hierarchy of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] serving in this position held the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].

==Overview==
{{Quote|So if you're a captain, and I'm a Jedi, then technically I outrank you, right?''"<br />"''In my book, ''experience'' outranks everything.|Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano talks to clone trooper captain [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]|<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
Formed in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Grand Army consisted of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were bred to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Jedi Order. Under the overall command of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], the Grand Army's [[Order of Battle/Legends|Order of Battle]] saw members of the Jedi Order placed in leadership positions. The ORBAT saw 80 generals placed in command of [[Corps/Legends|corps]] along with a [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]], and 320 in command of [[Legion/Legends|legions]] along with a [[senior clone commander]]. There were also ten [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi Generals]] in command of [[Systems Army/Legends|systems armies]], and twenty [[Senior Jedi General]]s in command of [[Sector Army/Legends|sector armies]]. For the sake of simplicity, Padawans considered suited for military duties were given the rank Jedi Commander and placed in charge of each of the army's 1,280 [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]].<ref name="GGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref><ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

[[File:RexTano-Counter.png|thumb|left|300px|Jedi Commanders held authority over the clone soldiers of the Republic Military]]
As a Padawan in the Jedi Order was only an apprentice, many were stationed at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the war if a General could not accompany them onto the battlefield. Senior Padawans remained on alert at the Temple, ready to be dispatched; younger Padawans, especially those who had lost their masters in the war, remained at the Temple doing research on strategy and running through advanced [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] training.<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

Some Padawans invoked the [[Right of Denial]], a right granted by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to refuse to take on a military rank. The High Council did not look fondly on those who shirked their duties to the Republic, requiring them to turn over their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to the Coruscant Temple.<ref name="Marching Orders">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050727marchingorders|text=Marching Orders|int=Marching Orders}}</ref>

When Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] betrayed the Order at the end of the war by issuing [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], most Jedi were caught off guard as their own troopers turned their blasters on them. Nearly every active Jedi, whether serving as a Commander or a General, was cut down by their own troopers in a single day.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> Those who survived were stripped of their rank and went into hiding, many being hunted down by the newly risen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]].<ref name="Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>

==Notable Jedi Commanders==
[[File:StrategicMudball-SWR55.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jedi Commander Anakin Skywalker fighting on the rain-soaked world of Jabiim]]
When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted, Padawan [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] was deep undercover on the planet [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]] when the war broke out on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and was therefore unaware of her new rank. When [[Omega Squad]] arrived on planet to rescue her from overwhelming odds, Tur-Mukan was coached by her loyal clones on how to lead and went on to liberate the planet. Joined by Padawan/Commander [[Bardan Jusik]], the two apprentices would successfully pass their [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] on the planet, organizing a local militia to work as a barrier against future occupation by the Confederacy.<ref name="Republic Commando: Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>

During the early stages of war, many Padawans lost their masters to the savage conflict. These Commanders, though still fledgling Jedi, were forced to lead their armies on their own through a battle until reinforcements arrived. During the [[Battle of Jabiim|bloody battle]] on [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], the so-called [[Padawan Pack]] was formed from Commanders who had lost their masters and were forced to survive through the battle on their own. While they fought valiantly, all members of the Pack met their demise on the battlefield except for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: The Battle of Jabiim" />

[[File:Jedi_Commander.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Some Jedi survived the purge and went on to serve as Jedi Commanders with the Rebellion.]]
When [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] became [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] Padawan, she became a commander.<ref name="TCWVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> As the war raged on, many Padawans felt the strain that such widespread conflict placed on Jedi principals. During the [[Battle of Thustra|fight]] on [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]], Padawans [[Cal (Jedi)|Cal]] and [[Pix (Jedi)|Pix]] were forced to lead their troopers after both their masters were killed in a suicide attack by the native [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]]. Disappointed when the diminutive [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived to negotiate peace with King [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]], Cal had hoped a more aggressive stance would have been taken to avenge his master. Accompanying Master Yoda to the capital, Cal grew restless with Master Yoda's patience when the two Jedi were placed under house-arrest by the king. Staging an escape, Padawan Cal was overwhelmed by attacking Sephi soldiers and died in Yoda's arms, cursing his name.<ref name="Jedi: Yoda">''[[Jedi: Yoda]]''</ref>

Padawans [[Codi Ty]] and [[Flynn Kybo]] joined Master [[B'dard Tone]] in an unsanctioned assassination mission to kill [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Supreme Commander of the Confederation military]]. While Tone and Kybo both died, Padawan Ty was stripped of his rank both as Commander and apprentice and exiled from the Order.<ref name="Star Wars: General Grievous">''[[Star Wars: General Grievous]]''</ref>

During the final days of the war, Commanders [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]], [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]], and [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]] gathered on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] with Masters [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] to end the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|ongoing battle]] there. While separate from their masters, the three Jedi intercepted a message from Coruscant just as the clones in the field received it. Directly from the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]], [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] had been issued: execute all Jedi. Fleeing the wrath of their clones, the Padawans made it offworld before being killed.<ref name="Evasive Action">''[[Evasive Action]]''</ref>
